MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  February 10, 2026

Chair Carbajal called the meeting to order at 5:18 p.m. in Conference Room 4, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call were Vice
Chair Gomez and Commissioner Salas. Also, present were Ozzie Ramos, Deputy City
Manager, Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst, and Svetlana Hernandez, Office
Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Flores motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International
Friendship Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on January 13, 2026.
Commissioner Gomez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Chair Carbajal, Vice Chair Gomez, Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None
ABSTAIN:  None

REPORTS

Discuss Sister Cities

The Commission discussed the possibilities of potential Sister Cities. Commissioners
agreed that the Sister City that is chosen should be representative of the Norwalk
community. The Commission decided to join the Sister Cities International Organization,
which Staff will be joining the membership on their behalf.

STAFF COMMENTS

Staff invited the Commissioners to the February 11, 2026, virtual conference collaboration
between California State University (CSU) and Sister Cities. Shirt sizes for the
Commissioners were also taken.

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

No Commissioner comment

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment
 ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:48 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
